name: labs/asvela__dlc-control
title: Toptica DLCpro laser controller (dlccontrol.DLCcontrol)
intro: Toptica DLCpro laser controller (dlccontrol.DLCcontrol), adapted from asvela/dlc-control. It reads `emission`, `emission_button`, `wavelength_actual`, `temp_actual` and 3 more; sets `current_enabled`, `wavelength_setpoint`, `temp_setpoint`, `scan_enabled` and 5 more; runs `emission_off`. `emission_off`: disable the laser diode current (the documented emission off control). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/asvela__dlc-control --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/asvela__dlc-control --backend fake --mcp
